title: Palak Paneer
description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a smooth, mildly spiced pureed spinach gravy — a restaurant-style favourite that's simple enough for a weeknight.
steps: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then transfer immediately to ice water to keep its colour. Drain and blend to a smooth puree.
Heat oil in a pan and lightly shallow-fry the paneer cubes until pale golden on the edges. Set aside (skip this step for a softer texture — the paneer can also be added raw).
In the same pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds. Once they sizzle, add the onion and sauté until translucent.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, cook for a minute, then add the tomato and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the spinach puree, garam masala and salt. Simmer for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gravy thickens slightly.
Add the paneer cubes and simmer for another 3-4 minutes so they soak up the flavour. Stir in the cream if using, and serve hot.
